name: El Tigre Cruises Ltd
summary: El Tigre runs two sailing catamarans, El Tigre and El Tigre II, along the west coast from Bridgetown. Each cruise stops twice to snorkel, once with sea turtles and once over shipwrecks, and drinks and snorkel gear come with every trip. The boats are licensed for 50 but carry no more than 36 guests.
standouts: Two sailing catamarans, 60 feet long and 24 feet wide
Licensed for 50 passengers, cruises limited to 36
Transport to and from the dock for south and west coast locations

contact.address: Cavans Lane, Bridgetown, St. Michael, Barbados W.I.

trips.title: 5-Hour Turtle & Shipwreck with Lunch
trips.summary: A five hour sail along the west coast with two snorkel stops, one with sea turtles and one over shipwrecks full of tropical fish. A third stop is for lunch on board and a swim, with time to swim to the beach, before sailing back to Bridgetown.
highlights: Two 45 minute snorkel stops, turtles and shipwrecks
Lunch on board at a third stop
Option to swim to the beach

trips.title: 3 Hour Turtle, Shipwreck Snorkel & Sail
trips.summary: A shorter morning sail along the west coast, leaving the dock at 10:00 and back at 13:00. You swim and snorkel with sea turtles and then over shipwrecks with tropical fish. The operator suggests it for families with small children.
highlights: Snorkel with turtles and over shipwrecks
Suited to families with small children

trips.title: Sunset Turtle & Shipwreck Snorkel
trips.summary: An evening sail from Bridgetown at 15:30 with snorkel stops over the shipwrecks and with sea turtles. The crew serve canapés and Prosecco as the boat sails the coast through sunset. It runs on Tuesdays and Thursdays and takes up to 18 guests.

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: Charter one of the catamarans for your own group, for a birthday, wedding, anniversary or company event. Charters run for at least three hours and are planned with the crew.
highlights: Corporate events, birthdays, weddings and anniversaries
trips.checkNotes: Contact us for pricing. Enquiry only, through the Private Charter Inquiry form at https://eltigrecruises.com/pages/PrivateGetQuote.php. Departure point not stated for charters.
